crew.overview: Charlie Kenton is a washed-up fighter who retired from the ring when robots took over the sport. After his robot is trashed, he reluctantly teams up with his estranged son to rebuild and train an unlikely contender.
crew.title: Real Steel

crew.overview: When an unexpected enemy emerges and threatens global safety and security, Nick Fury, director of the international peacekeeping agency known as S.H.I.E.L.D., finds himself in need of a team to pull the world back from the brink of disaster. Spanning the globe, a daring recruitment effort begins!
crew.title: The Avengers

crew.overview: After the devastating events of Avengers: Infinity War, the universe is in ruins due to the efforts of the Mad Titan, Thanos. With the help of remaining allies, the Avengers must assemble once more in order to undo Thanos' actions and restore order to the universe once and for all, no matter what consequences may be in store.
crew.title: Avengers: Endgame

crew.overview: Peter Parker is unmasked and no longer able to separate his normal life from the high-stakes of being a super-hero. When he asks for help from Doctor Strange the stakes become even more dangerous, forcing him to discover what it truly means to be Spider-Man.
crew.title: Spider-Man: No Way Home

crew.original_title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
crew.overview: Shang-Chi must confront the past he thought he left behind when he is drawn into the web of the mysterious Ten Rings organization.
crew.title: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings

crew.overview: Natasha Romanoff, also known as Black Widow, confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises. Pursued by a force that will stop at nothing to bring her down, Natasha must deal with her history as a spy and the broken relationships left in her wake long before she became an Avenger.
crew.title: Black Widow

crew.overview: As the Avengers and their allies have continued to protect the world from threats too large for any one hero to handle, a new danger has emerged from the cosmic shadows: Thanos. A despot of intergalactic infamy, his goal is to collect all six Infinity Stones, artifacts of unimaginable power, and use them to inflict his twisted will on all of reality. Everything the Avengers have fought for has led up to this moment - the fate of Earth and existence itself has never been more uncertain.
crew.title: Avengers: Infinity War

crew.overview: The ultimate X-Men ensemble fights a war for the survival of the species across two time periods as they join forces with their younger selves in an epic battle that must change the past – to save our future.
crew.title: X-Men: Days of Future Past

crew.overview: When Tony Stark's world is torn apart by a formidable terrorist called the Mandarin, he starts an odyssey of rebuilding and retribution.
crew.title: Iron Man 3

crew.original_title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button
crew.overview: Born under unusual circumstances, Benjamin Button springs into being as an elderly man in a New Orleans nursing home and ages in reverse. Twelve years after his birth, he meets Daisy, a child who flits in and out of his life as she grows up to be a dancer. Though he has all sorts of unusual adventures over the course of his life, it is his relationship with Daisy, and the hope that they will come together at the right time, that drives Benjamin forward.
crew.title: The Curious Case of Benjamin Button

crew.overview: The story of the battle of Iwo Jima between the United States and Imperial Japan during World War II, as told from the perspective of the Japanese who fought it.
crew.title: Letters from Iwo Jima

crew.overview: In 2035, where robots are commonplace and abide by the three laws of robotics, a technophobic cop investigates an apparent suicide. Suspecting that a robot may be responsible for the death, his investigation leads him to believe that humanity may be in danger.
crew.title: I, Robot

crew.overview: A mysterious man arrives at the offices of an FBI agent and recounts his childhood: how his religious fanatic father received visions telling him to kill people who were in fact "demons."
crew.title: Frailty

details.biography:
Michael Melchiorre is a visual effects supervisor at Digital Domain, where over the past two decades he has established himself as both a compositing supervisor and a visual effects supervisor. His compositing expertise can be traced through a substantial roster of film and episodic projects, including Real Steel (2011), Avengers: Infinity War (2018), Avengers: Endgame (2019), Terminator: Dark Fate (2019), Black Widow (2021), and Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021). Beyond film, he played pivotal roles in television and streaming productions, serving as compositing supervisor on The Mandalorian (2023, Season 3) and ascending to visual effects supervisor for Ahsoka (2023, Season 1), where he helped craft a battle sequence in the Red Forest.

His evolution to visual effects supervisor marked a significant expansion in responsibility. One high-profile example was She-Hulk: Attorney at Law (2022), where he won a Telly Award in 2023 for Best Visual Effects. In this role, he helped bring the titular character to life through around 45 minutes of photorealistic, emotionally expressive, CG-animated performance that exceeded expectations for episodic production quality. His contributions also include compositing work on the video game Tom Clancy’s The Division 2, for which he received a Telly Award in 2020 for Best Compositing.

Michael has also earned recognition within his professional community. He was nominated twice for prestigious Visual Effects Society (VES) Awards: first for Outstanding Compositing in a Photoreal Episode for Black Sails (2017), and later for Outstanding Compositing and Lighting in a Feature for Black Widow (2022).

Michael served as a visual effects supervisor for Agatha All Along (2024), the WandaVision (2021) spin-off miniseries, where Digital Domain served as lead vendor. He supervised effects for key moments such as the “Witches’ Road” and magical combat sequences. He also contributed as compositing supervisor on Captain America: Brave New World (2025).
details.name: Michael Melchiorre
